0.5.3-beta / versionCode 20 — retained wireless import confirmation session
Date: 2026-10-17

Delivery
  APK: nikon-usb-0.5.3-beta-debug.apk
  Size: 2716281 bytes
  SHA-256: 385a893a7b4865246f7c72292a613f4cbb9f3bbc4590d5ca6248b62a56d15098
  scripts/build-apk.ps1 completed; v2/v3 signatures verified.

Problem and fix
  User screenshots show EHOSTUNREACH before a registration request was sent.
  Old code closed its probe session and both sockets before confirmation, then
  attempted a fresh connection for import. Camera AP shutdown in response is an
  inference from the symptom, not independently proved Nikon behavior.
  prepareImport now retains its owned session and both sockets. Confirmation
  schedules a read-only Standard query every 10 seconds on the serial worker.
  importPreparedNcpPreset transfers that same session and next transaction ID;
  it cannot connect to a new endpoint. It freshly reads DeviceInfo/capability,
  all nine slots and the target again, permits at most one registration and
  verifies exact readback. No automatic reconnect or registration retry.
  Cancel/back/root switch release the owned session; teardown cancels or drains
  pending work as appropriate. Heartbeat failures end confirmation with no write.
  Independent settings probes and recovery remain standalone read-only flows.
  Socket routing remains pinned to one selected Android Wi-Fi Network.

Automated verification
  tests/run.ps1: 8212 checks passed.
  tests/run-probe.ps1: 5686 checks passed:
    ordinary USB probe 685; Picture Control read-only 453;
    USB copy/adaptation 1004; wireless 3544.
  Total: 13898. Historical library checks are not added to this count.
  New retained-session regressions cover a peer refusing reconnection after
  CloseSession, monotonic transaction handoff, same sockets, complete fresh
  preflight, changed model/operation/capability/slot, cancellation/concurrency,
  peer loss, cleanup acknowledgement failures and unknown-result no-retry paths.
  Synthetic UI server self-tests passed; normal album/read-only modes retain
  their write rejection. Production source and MainActivity lifecycle received
  independent reviews with no remaining P1/P2 finding.

Final-APK native UI integration
  Temporary read-only Pixel 9 emulator, Android 17/API 37, 1080x2424.
  A hand-written PreviewTone.NCP was imported via the Android document picker.
  The server listened only on 127.0.0.1; emulator used 10.0.2.2:15743.
  All virtual slots were process memory. No real-camera or phone Wi-Fi control.
  On CloseSession the server rejects new InitCommand handshakes to reproduce
  the old close/reconnect gap; it does not shut down any physical Wi-Fi network.

  Success: first nine-slot scan ended 01:24:27.919Z; fresh import DeviceInfo at
  01:26:40.255Z, a 132.336-second confirmation wait with 13 Standard heartbeats.

Physical phone installation

  adb install --user 0 -r succeeded, preserving existing application data.
  Package reports versionCode 20, versionName 0.5.3-beta, installed=true.
  Installed base.apk SHA-256 exactly matches the delivery hash above.
  No test presets added to the phone; no foreground UI manipulation or camera
  operation during this installation. No physical-camera registration tested.

Limits
  Synthetic success proves the repaired application connection lifetime, not
  Z6II AP policy, firmware acceptance, Nikon proprietary pairing or Wi-Fi quality.
  Real Z6II retest should include waiting 30-60 seconds on confirmation before
  importing into an empty slot and reviewing the resulting report.
  Existing strict NCP subset and phone-template approximation remain unchanged.
  No new camera-effect, TalkBack, tablet, gesture or performance claim.
